node.title: Conjecture F: plane sections of D_j have poly unpaid points
node.statement: For every linear P <= P^j and pair (u,v): the D_j-points of P are, up to n^{B_F} exceptions, covered by a shared divisor of degree >= j - dim P - O(log_n) (tangent shape) or a proper quotient-pullback stratum (periodic shape).
node.attack_surface: prove coordinate planes first (= prob:perfiber, minimal instance), then kernel planes; the crux is classifying exceptional planes (ES-type)
node.falsifier: a toy-scale plane family (n = 16..32, enumerable) with super-poly D_j points, no deep shared divisor, no pullback symmetry
node.notes: FLIP on replay (Codex wave 7): assembly conditional — gcd-reduction + scale-recursion PROVED; closes on f_primitive_case.
